submission.justification: Crystal-K1 has the best simulated resolution (2.9% FWHM at 662 keV) but its measured intrinsic background of 2.0 counts/kg/day (100-3000 keV) is four times the 0.5 counts/kg/day hard limit, so it is excluded. Crystal-K2 meets the background limit (0.10) but has poor resolution (8.5%). Crystal-K3 meets the limit (0.30 +- 0.05) and gives 4.5% FWHM at 662 keV, the best of the compliant options. The 2025 simulation reports only weak thickness dependence over 3-8 cm and gives results at a nominal 5 cm, so 5 cm is recommended as the simulated baseline; no thickness-specific optimum was available in the documents. The thickness is an inferred choice, not a tested optimum.

requirements.requirement: Crystal must be one of the three candidates
Best achievable energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: Among background-compliant candidates, K3 gives 4.5% FWHM vs 8.5% for K2 (2025 simulation, 5 cm). K1 (2.9%) is excluded by the background constraint. Thickness dependence is weak over 3-8 cm, so 5 cm is not claimed as an optimum.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended crystal and thickness
